mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 71 degrees with partly cloudy skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. Under a waning gibbous moon, keep an eye on the sky at 5:50 AM to spot the International Space Station rising in the northwest over Verona High School and traveling east toward Fitchburg, peaking about halfway up the sky.

September 2026 is designated as Hunger Action Month in Verona to combat food insecurity affecting 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin. Additionally, be aware that flagging will occur on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday for utility work, so please plan for potential travel delays.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, free girls try hockey at the Verona Ice Arena, and live music at both Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and trivia at local favorites like Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's early next week.
In our weekly report, on August 17, the department arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store will open today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
